name: dale
description: One-on-one brainstorming, repository indexing, adaptive task graphs, high-assurance review loops, and standalone HTML visualization for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Brainstorm, index, graph, verify, and visualize.
interface.longDescription: Dale supports focused brainstorming, evidence-backed repository primitives, adaptive graphs of visible Codex tasks, resident-worker review loops for consequential work, and self-contained HTML visualizations selected from task-relevant patterns.
defaultPrompt: Brainstorm this idea with me one-on-one.
Synthesize a Dale graph for this task.
Run this consequential task through Dale Max.
Turn this material into a standalone HTML visualization.
